title: [YouPass Collect] - Party Booking at Shaw's Restaurant

parts.title: Listening Passage 1
parts.transcriptHtml:
Restaurant Staff: Good morning, Shaw’s Restaurant.

Maria: Hi. I’d like to book one of your function rooms for a party, please.

Restaurant Staff: Okay. Fine. How many people are you expecting for the party?

Maria: Well, I’m not quite sure yet, but about 60.

Restaurant Staff: Fine. So you will need a big room. And what day were you thinking of?

Maria: The party’s for my daughter’s birthday. It’s her twenty first. Her birthday’s actually on the 18th of November, but that’s a Friday, So we thought we’d have her party on the 18th as that’s a Saturday. There’ll be lots of her friends there as well as all the family.

Restaurant Staff: And what time would you like the room for?

Maria: Oh, I’m not sure. 07:45? Not too late.

Restaurant Staff: Okay.

Maria: And people will probably be leaving about eleven.

Restaurant Staff: Fine. We’re open until 11:30.

Maria: Excellent. And what about the menu?

Restaurant Staff: So do you want a sit down meal with waiter service?

Maria: Yes. Not a buffet.

Restaurant Staff: Right. Well, there are several options including different menus at various prices. So there’s the standard menu, that’s £25 per person.

Maria: Okay.

Restaurant Staff: Or the celebration menu which is three courses, it’s very popular, that’s £35.

Maria: Okay. I think I’d rather go with that.

Restaurant Staff: And there’s also our gold menu. That’s a five course menu at £50.

Maria: No. That’s definitely too expensive.

Restaurant Staff: Okay.

Maria: Now not all the guests eat meat. Will there be something for them?

Restaurant Staff: Of course. We’ll make sure there’s a vegetarian option for each course.

Maria: Great.

Restaurant Staff: And do you know if any of the guests have food allergies? Anything like shellfish, for example?

Maria: I’ll need to check, but I do know that one of my daughter’s friends is very allergic to strawberries. Even just being near them can be a problem.

Restaurant Staff: Okay. I’ll make a note to our chef to avoid those completely. Do you have any other requests for desserts?

Maria: Well, I’d like a choice if possible. And could we have cheese as well?

Restaurant Staff: Of course. No problem. We can provide that.

Restaurant Staff: Now do you have any other requests I could help with? What about after dinner entertainment? You can book a band if you’d like live music.

Maria: Actually, I think a disco would be best if you can arrange that.

Restaurant Staff: No problem.

Maria: And I heard you might be able to put on a fireworks display. Is that possible?

Restaurant Staff: We aren’t offering that service anymore, I’m afraid. It was just too expensive.

Maria: Oh, I see.

Restaurant Staff: Now the menu package you’ve chosen includes a few other nice things.

Maria: Oh, like what?

Restaurant Staff: We’ll decorate the room for you, which creates a nice party atmosphere. We can use different colors for the balloons: silver, gold.

Maria: She loves pink, but actually, I think she’d prefer flowers to balloons. So let’s go for them instead in the same color.

Restaurant Staff: No problem. Now you mentioned that the party’s for your daughter. We make birthday cakes if you’d like one.

Maria: Okay. Yes. We’ll definitely want a cake.

Restaurant Staff: And we can put a special message on top. What would you like?

Maria: Congratulations and then her name. That’s Susie.

Restaurant Staff: Fine.

Maria: Now, one or two of the guests are coming by train, but they stop running quite early, so they’ll need a taxi to take them to the Forest Hotel after the party. Is that something you can sort out?

Restaurant Staff: Absolutely. Anything else?

Maria: I think that’s all for now.

Restaurant Staff: Okay. Well, just get in touch if you think of anything else. Now if I can just take some contact details, I just need your name and phone number.

Maria: I’m Maria Nelson, and my number’s 07749132760.

Restaurant Staff: Excellent. We look forward to seeing you soon.

questionSets.title: Questions 1-5
questionSets.instructionHtml:
Complete the notes below. 

Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
questionSets.contentHtml:
Example: Number of guests for the party: 60 people
Starting time of the party: ______ pm
Menu options:
  • The standard ($25)
  • The ______ ($35)
  • The gold ($50)
Each course has some ______ option
One guest is allergic to ______
Other requests: desserts and ______

questionSets.title: Questions 6-10
questionSets.instructionHtml: Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
questionSets.contentHtml:
Entertainment: book a ______ after dinner
Room decoration: pink ______
Special request:
  • write ______ 'Susie' on the birthday cake
  • book a ______ to take guests to the Forest Hotel
Phone number: ______
